task: Semantic segmentation of oil spills in Sentinel-1 SAR imagery

licenses: Code-generated synthetic tiles; no external imagery dataset is documented
training_data.synthetic: The only committed runnable training entry point generates synthetic tiles on the fly.
training_data.split_method: NOT_RECORDED; no committed held-out scene split

intended_use: Investigative support for maritime domain awareness. Identify potential oil slicks for further investigation.
limitations: Look-alikes (biogenic films, wind shadows, low-wind zones, rain cells) cause false positives
Performance varies by region/season not in training data
CFAR ship detection is separate and not validated by this model

calibration.note: Confidence should not be interpreted as probability

ethical_considerations: This system provides investigative leads only, not proof. All outputs require human verification and independent corroboration.

reproducibility.split_verification: NOT_AVAILABLE; no documented real-data scene split
